reconcile.note: Clarke treats the spittle in both healings as a natural step to loosen the eyelids, with the actual miracle worked through Jesus's touch.

sides.snippet: When he had spit on his eyes, and laid his hands on him
sides.verseText: He took hold of the blind man by the hand, and brought him out of the village. When he had spit on his eyes, and laid his hands on him, he asked him if he saw anything.

sides.snippet: he spat on the ground, made mud with the saliva, anointed the blind man's eyes with the mud
sides.verseText: When he had said this, he spat on the ground, made mud with the saliva, anointed the blind man's eyes with the mud,
